description: Open agent protocols the product supports first-party, as a sorted comma-separated set: mcp-server (ships an MCP server), mcp-client (consumes MCP servers), a2a (Agent2Agent), openai-compatible (serves an OpenAI-compatible API), ag-ui (AG-UI event protocol), opentelemetry (emits or ingests OpenTelemetry/OpenInference traces), or none.
